# Town and Tourist

> > Your comprehensive guide to family-friendly travel, outdoor adventures, and road trip itineraries across the United States.

Town and Tourist provides detailed travel guides, hiking trail recommendations, beach destinations, and road trip itineraries primarily focused on U.S. destinations. The site specializes in family travel, dog-friendly outdoor activities, and practical travel tips for planning memorable adventures from the Catskills to Costa Rica.

- United States Travel

- Texas & Dallas
- Waterfall Hikes
- Beginner-Friendly Hikes
- Travel Tips & Planning
